questions.question: Fill in the blank (Difficulty 1): In Python, every 'if' statement must end with a ______.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 2): The code inside an 'if' statement is grouped using ______ in Python.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 3): When you have multiple exclusive conditions, use 'if', ______, and 'else' in a sequence.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 4): An 'if' statement only executes its code block if the condition evaluates to ______.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 5): To check for the opposite of a condition, use the ______ keyword before the condition in an if-statement.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 6): We often combine conditions with the 'and' operator, which returns True only if ______ conditions are True.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 7): If we want to ignore certain conditions within an 'if' block, we can use the ______ statement as a placeholder.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 8): The '______' operator checks if a specific value is part of a sequence or collection within an if-condition.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 9): When comparing object identity rather than equality, use the '______' keyword in an if-statement.
Fill in the blank (Difficulty 10): Nested if-statements involve placing one if-statement ______ another while considering multiple levels of logic.
